enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in on the public holiday
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up to chest. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow under head. Sleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Sleep. Wake briefly. Open eyes. Look at clock. Close eyes. Turn to back. Sleep. Move legs. Stretch arms. Turn to left side. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering, brushing teeth and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Sit up on bed. Swing legs over side. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Wet body. Pick up soap. Rub soap on body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around waist. Walk to sink. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth. Put toothbrush back. Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Pick up shirt. Put on shirt. Pick up pants. Put on pants. Pick up socks. Put on socks. Pick up shoes. Put on shoes. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a relaxed breakfast of toast and tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Take out butter. Take out jam. Close refrigerator. Place bread on cutting board. Pick up knife. Spread butter on bread. Spread jam on bread. Place bread in toaster. Press lever down. Wait for toast. Pick up kettle. Fill with water. Place on base. Turn on kettle. Open cupboard. Take out mug. Take out tea bag. Place tea bag in mug. Wait for kettle to boil. Pour water into mug. Remove tea bag. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Pour milk into mug. Close refrigerator. Take toast from toaster. Place on plate. Sit at table. Pick up toast. Eat toast. Sip tea. Continue eating. Finish breakfast. Stand up. Carry plate to sink. Rinse plate. Place in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Sorting laundry and starting a load in the washing machine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Open laundry basket. Pick up white shirt. Check label. Place in white pile. Pick up colored shirt. Check label. Place in colored pile. Pick up pants. Check label. Place in colored pile. Pick up towel. Check label. Place in white pile. Continue sorting all clothes. Pick up white pile. Walk to washing machine. Open washing machine door. Place white clothes inside. Close door. Open detergent drawer. Pour detergent. Close drawer. Turn dial to select cycle. Press start button. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying business course readings on the computer at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Press power button on computer. Wait for boot. Log in. Open browser. Type URL. Press enter. Navigate to course page. Open reading material. Read. Scroll down. Pick up pen. Write notes in notebook. Highlight text with highlighter. Put down highlighter. Continue reading. Scroll up. Re-read section. Write more notes. Check time. Continue reading. Finish reading. Close browser. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Grocery shopping and grabbing a coffee nearby
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Ride to station. Get off bus. Walk to grocery store. Enter store. Pick up basket. Walk to produce aisle. Pick up apples. Place in basket. Pick up bananas. Place in basket. Walk to dairy aisle. Pick up milk. Place in basket. Pick up eggs. Place in basket. Walk to bakery. Pick up bread. Place in basket. Walk to checkout. Place items on counter. Pay. Bag items. Exit store. Walk to coffee shop. Enter. Order coffee. Pay. Wait for coffee. Receive coffee. Exit. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Ride home. Walk home. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Chop chicken. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir. Add vegetables. Add spices. Stir. Cook. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat. Drink water. Finish. Stand up. Carry plate to sink. Rinse plate. Place in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Hanging the washed laundry up to dry
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine door. Take out shirt. Shake it. Hang on drying rack. Take out pants. Shake. Hang. Take out towel. Shake. Hang. Take out socks. Pair them. Hang. Continue until all clothes hung. Close washing machine door. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on a university assignment on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Open assignment file. Read instructions. Type. Scroll. Pause. Re-read. Type more. Delete sentence. Retype. Save. Open reference. Copy citation. Paste. Type. Check word count. Continue typing. Save again. Close file. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV to take a break
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Select channel. Watch. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch. Pick up phone. Check message. Put down phone. Watch. Change channel. Watch. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing lecture notes and planning the coming study week
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open notebook. Read notes. Open planner. Write tasks. Pick up pen. Write. Close planner. Close notebook. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Cook. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat. Drink water. Finish. Stand up. Carry plate to sink. Rinse plate. Place in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Going for an evening walk around the neighbourhood
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Walk down driveway. Turn left onto sidewalk. Walk along street. Pass house with red door. Walk past park. Turn right at intersection. Walk along path. See dog. Walk past. Turn around. Walk back. Walk up driveway. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Playing games on the console and relaxing
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up controller. Turn on console. Select game. Press start. Play. Press buttons. Move joystick. Pause game. Pick up drink. Sip. Put down drink. Resume game. Play. Save game. Turn off console. Put down controller. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking emails and browsing on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Open email client. Read email. Reply. Send. Open next email. Read. Delete. Open browser. Type URL. Press enter. Browse website. Scroll. Click link. Read. Close browser. Close email client. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Scrolling on the phone under the desk lamp before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up phone. Unlock. Open social media app. Scroll. Tap on post. Read. Scroll. Tap on video. Watch. Scroll. Like post. Scroll. Open messaging app. Read message. Type reply. Send. Scroll. Lock phone. Put down phone. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.
Walk to bed. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Sleep. Wake briefly. Open eyes. Close eyes. Turn to back. Sleep.
